stage: Prospective external-shoot validation; frozen before encoding any new query
baselineRule: Keep accepted PP matches, otherwise admit only DINO top-one above its frozen threshold when it equals PP raw top-one ID
guardedRule: Apply the baseline rule; for an agreement fallback additionally require the PP top-one score to exceed the next different product score by at least .05. Abstain if no competing product is available. Preserve existing PP matches.
selection: A round .05 product-level PP ambiguity gap was selected using the already observed development confusion (.014 gap after removing Strawberry Banana); old recoveries had .167 and .191 gaps. It is not tuned on the new photographs and is not a proof of open-set correctness.
gallery: Frozen 38-photo field shop from the previous experiment; no new query or source shoot is indexed
views: Same full frame plus at most five PicoDet proposals for both encoders, no manual regions, no rotations/color synthesis or OCR ranking
negativeTests: Real absent flavors; separately remove each present target product and all of its photos in memory
units: Unique source photo/frame; report photographer/review/video groups and do not treat neighboring video frames or leave-target-out conditions as independent captures
activation: Offline benchmark only; no app change, provider inference, database mutation, deployment or training
